notes: Reference is the embedded v0.2.2 copying Pipeline control in the same executable, not a separately built historical release.
Runs are serial with rotated algorithm order and no concurrent build. Desktop scheduling remains uncontrolled; entropy wall times vary widely.
Stage columns contain independent medians; their sum need not equal the median total. Quantize excludes color preparation and dither/map.
RSS is whole-process high-water usage including setup, reference fitting and export, not an allocator-only peak.
The longer control uses 3 rotated processes with 20 renders each (one cold, nineteen warm), on the same measured executable.
All 210 independently decoded outputs preserve expected bounds; default/reference wire and pixels match in all 42 comparisons and both cache passes.

Direct conversion preserves decoded pixels in all measured cases, but its encoded transparency stream can differ. Different floating accumulation does not establish universal equivalence or justify unconditional selection.
No terminal transfer or physical display latency is inferred. Foot qualification validates behavior and wire pixels separately.

notes: Three repeated processes per representative/stress workload.
Setup and fallback font initialization are outside operation timers.
Process resources include fixture generation and setup.
Frames use TestBackend; physical terminal latency is not measured.
Retained reports describe their measured revision only.
Native encoders are measured; physical emulator/display time is not.
Inspector zoom and pan use original bytes or re-rendered SVG paths.
Cold and reused raster sources are timed separately; one source is retained.
Bidirectional scrolling checks 24 clips without new image work.
Sixel clips copy cached cell-height strips without decoding again.
